player_prompt.intro:
Uzuzuona {N} zithambo zikukhazikika kwa mtundu.
Kwa kila chezo tipite [accept] kukhala *thambo la pano*, kapena [continue] kukuthowa kuti uzuzune lililonso.
Ukunja kukhala, mwachindika kukukhala thambo la mwisho.
Mwawina (cholinga = 1) **pamoza** ukuthambo wakukhala ukulu wakuthambo wose.
